query: Which validated scales or concrete survey items best measure administrative burden, perceived legitimacy/fairness, self‑censorship, and emotional labour in SSH research?

response.query: Which validated scales or concrete survey items best measure administrative burden, perceived legitimacy/fairness, self‑censorship, and emotional labour in SSH research?
response.answer: Administrative burden: Survey items from the Public Administration Survey; perceived legitimacy/fairness: Legitimacy Scale; self-censorship: Self-Censorship Scale; emotional labour: Emotional Labour Scale.

results.title: Granted projects | NWO
results.content: The proposed project aims to develop a new creative method - Affect Houses - to investigate the role of emotions in the encounters between burned-out teachers and their occupational physician. Moving beyond language, the proposed project explores the possibilities of an embodied approach to research in order to 1) give participants tools to express the full complexity and depth of their experiences regarding sick leave and return-to-work; 2) create opportunities for empathic understanding of these experiences; and 3) offer suggestions for improving return-to-work practices in education. This project breaks new ground by linking, for the first time, all Dutch criminal case records to rich population-wide data on work, health, and families. This project aims to contribute original evidence on the novel concept of digital labor by developing a measurement instrument, collecting representative data and providing descriptive and explanatory analyses of the involvement, division, antecedents and consequences of digital labor in Dutch households.
